name: Clearing System Member Identification 3 Choice
definition: Choice of identifiers for a clearing system member, as assigned by the clearing system. In some clearing systems, the accounts of the clearing system members are also assigned an identifier.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification for a clearing system member, identified in the list of clearing system member identifications published externally.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Identification Code for a clearing system, that has not yet been identified in the list of clearing systems.
